description: Format raw changelog bullets into the project's release-note line format.

evals.name: Mixed types grouped in documented order
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- refactor: split the parser into two modules (#31)
- bug: crash when the config file is empty (#12)
- docs: explain the retry settings (#27)
- feature: add dark mode toggle (#40)
- bug: wrong total on empty cart (#15)
- feature: export report as CSV (#41)
evals.expected_output: One line per bullet in the form `- [<TYPE>] <Summary> (#<id>)`, grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS, CHORE with input order kept inside each group (refactor maps to CHORE). FEAT: dark mode toggle (#40), export report as CSV (#41); FIX: crash when the config file is empty (#12), wrong total on empty cart (#15); DOCS: explain the retry settings (#27); CHORE: split the parser into two modules (#31). Summaries are sentence case, no trailing period, at most 60 characters.

evals.name: Bullet without issue number gets (#none)
evals.prompt:
Format these changelog bullets as release notes:
- feature: add keyboard shortcuts (#52)
- bug: tooltip flickers on hover
- docs: fix typo in install guide (#53)
evals.expected_output: Three lines grouped FEAT, FIX, DOCS. The bug bullet has no issue number and is rendered `- [FIX] Tooltip flickers on hover (#none)`; the other two keep their numbers (#52, #53).
